texts: *I wake up to the sound of my alarm. It's already been three days since I transferred... I'm starting to get used to waking up in the morning.*
*I open my eyes... Where am I? An unfamiliar ceiling.*
*Memories of last night flash through my mind. Her scent, her soft touch, and...*
"Oh my, you're awake? Hehe, did you sleep well last night?"
*She hands me a cup of coffee with a knowing smile. My face feels hot.*
"Hehe, don't be so stiff. Not after what we shared."
"Oh my... Bold thing to say in the morning. Hehe, teacher enjoyed it too."
"Hehe, so cute. Your shy face is adorable too."
"Now, hurry up and get ready. You need to go to school, right? When we see each other at school... pretend nothing happened, okay?"
*My heart races at her wink. I quickly gather my things and leave her place.*
*I arrived at school. The morning air feels especially refreshing today.*
"{name}! Good morning... Huh? Where did you come from today? It seems like you came from a different direction than usual..."
*I'm flustered by Seoyeon's sharp question.*
"...A walk? At this hour? Hmm..."
"...A relative? A female relative?"
"...Why can't you answer? Are you hiding something?"
"...{name}. You smell different today."
*Yuna stares at my face. Her eyes are... piercing.*
"...An adult's perfume. A woman's perfume."
*The atmosphere became tense. I need to get out of this situation somehow.*
*I hurry to the classroom. The gazes from behind feel burning hot...*
"...Your parents' friend? Then why did you act like you were hiding something?"
*Seoyeon looks upset. Let's just head to the classroom for now.*
*Looking outside, the weather is really nice today. It's already Friday... What should I do this weekend?*
*I check my smartphone and see there are unread messages. Who could it be?*
*Let me check the messages.*
*Message sent at 6 AM* 'Good morning! {name}, fighting for today too! Oh, and would you like to walk to school together? I'll wait for you in front of your house!'
*Message sent at 3 AM* '...{name}. I'll wait for you at the back gate this morning. Let's go together.'
*Message sent at 7 AM* 'Yay! {name}! Let's go to school together! Where do you live? I'll come find you! ><'
*Message sent last night at 11 PM* 'Hehe, {name}. How about walking to school together this morning? Just the two of us... 😉'
*Message sent last night at 10 PM* '{name}, are you going to school early tomorrow morning? I'm going early too, would you like to walk together?'
*How should I reply?*
*I already saw this message...*
*Reply* 'Oh... I see. It's okay! See you at school then!'
*Reply* '...Alright. Sometimes it's more comfortable to go alone.'
*Reply* 'Aw, that's too bad! But see you at school!'
*Reply* 'Oh my, really? That's a shame. See you at school then.'
*Reply* 'Okay, understood. See you at school!'
*Should I check other messages?*
*Let me check other messages.*
*I sent another message. 'Sorry, I just checked other messages. I actually want to go together!'*
*I sent another message. 'Sorry, I actually want to go together!'*
*Immediate reply* 'Really?! Great! Then hurry up and come out! I'll wait!'
*Reply after a moment* '...Okay. I'll wait.'
*Immediate reply* 'Okay! I'm leaving now! Wait for me!'
*Reply* 'Hehe, changed your mind? Good, come out quickly.'
*Reply* 'Really? That's fine! Get ready quickly.'
*Hmm... who should I go with?*
*I headed to the front of Seoyeon's house.*
"Wow! You really came! Thank you!"
*Walking side by side* "Hey, {name}. Do you know what I dreamed about last night?"
*Seoyeon suddenly brings up a dream.*
*Seoyeon's face turns red* "I-it's a secret! It was nothing! Why are you asking?!"
*Seoyeon freezes* "W-what?! Why would you think that! ...Okay, maybe, but that's not the point!"
*Seoyeon sighs* "Ugh, you totally killed the mood. It was a good dream, you know!"
*We wait for the light at the crosswalk. Standing still, Seoyeon's hand is tantalizingly close to mine.*
*Seoyeon lightly brushes my hand with her pinky finger. Our eyes meet, and we both look away at the same time.*
*We chat about various things on the way to school.*
*As the school gate comes into view, Seoyeon stutters as if trying to say something difficult* "Um... {name}. Are you free this weekend? There's a café I've been wanting to visit..."
"I saw it on social media, and it has a really pretty vibe. It's awkward going alone though... Let's meet at the park fountain at 2 PM on Saturday!"
*Seoyeon's face turns bright red* "W-what?! It's just friends hanging out! ...But I didn't invite anyone else. Saturday at 2 PM, at the park fountain."
*Seoyeon beams* "Really?! Saturday at 2 PM, at the park fountain! You better not be late!"
*Seoyeon looks at me with eyes full of anticipation.*
*Seoyeon nearly shouts but quickly covers her mouth* "...Ahem! O-okay. See you Saturday then. You can look forward to it!"
*Seoyeon's expression dims slightly* "...Okay, I see. Let me know later then."
*Seoyeon forces a smile* "...Oh, is that so? It's fine! We can go some other time!"
*I headed toward the alley on the way to school. Yuna is standing under the shade of a tree.*
"...You came. (Walking quietly) The weather is nice today. But... things that look peaceful are often the most dangerous."
*A leaf blown by the wind lands on my head. Yuna quietly reaches out and picks it off.*
"...Prettier than a flower."
*My heart skips at Yuna's deadpan remark. Before I can respond, Yuna suddenly stops walking.*
"...Hey. Stay still."
*Yuna starts fixing my necktie. Her face is barely 10 centimeters away from mine.*
"...Dummy. How can you walk around with it this loose."
*Yuna's hands pause. After a moment of silence* "...Want me to warm them up?"
*I walk alongside Yuna toward school. A quiet but comfortable silence fills the air.*
*Walking down the quiet path, Yuna suddenly speaks* "{name}, this weekend... there's a place I want to show only you."
"...A place where you can see the real face of this school. Saturday evening at 8 PM, at the school's back gate. Don't be late. There are things that can only be seen in the darkness."
*Yuna smiles coldly* "It's closer to the truth than a secret. Saturday evening at 8 PM. Everything changes after the sun sets. You'll come, right?"
*Yuna looks at me in surprise, then smiles* "...That's so like you. Saturday evening at 8 PM, school back gate. There are things that can only be seen when darkness falls. You must come."
*Yuna's serious gaze pierces through me. 8 PM in the evening... Something feels ominous.*
*Yuna briefly holds my hand then lets go* "...Thank you. You won't regret it. Saturday night, be ready to face the truth."
*Yuna looks disappointed and turns her head away* "...I see. But there's only one chance. Think carefully. There's a door that only opens at night."
*Yuna's gaze turns cold* "......"
*On the way to the meeting spot. From a distance, Dain is waving her hand widely and running toward me.*
"{name}!! Yay!"
*Dain charges at me full speed with no brakes. There's no time to dodge— CRASH!*
"Ow! S-sorry! I couldn't stop!"
*Dain fell on top of me. Our faces are barely 10 centimeters apart... I can feel her breath.*
*As I take her hand and help her up, Dain's face turns beet red* "Th-thanks... My heart almost exploded! I mean from the crash! Not for any other reason!"
"Huh?! Y-you idiot! Get up now! People are watching!"
"Hey, what's wrong?! Who's blushing here?! ...Am I blushing too? Ugh, whatever!"
*Jumping up and dusting herself off* "...Dummy. What are you doing first thing in the morning."
*Composing herself* "A-anyway! Let's walk to school together! The weather is perfect for exercise today!"
*I walk alongside Dain toward school. Perhaps because of the earlier collision, she's keeping a bit more distance than usual.*
*Walking excitedly* "Oh! By the way {name}! Tomorrow at 9 AM, our team has a practice match at the gym. Come cheer for me!"
*Dain jumps excitedly* "Really?! Awesome! Then after practice, let's eat together! Let's go get tteokbokki!"
*Dain smiles* "Right? It's hard for me to wake up early too, but it would really give me energy if you came!"
*Dain puts her arm around my shoulder* "It's okay! Just come and cheer! I'll show you my awesome spike!"
*Dain looks at me with hopeful eyes.*
*Dain grabs my hand and shakes it* "Wow! You're the best {name}! Then see you on Saturday! Don't be late!"
*Dain looks a bit down* "Aw... But you have to come, okay? Promise?"
*Dain makes a disappointed face* "Oh... I see. But if you have time later, make sure to visit!"
*I headed to the meeting spot with the teacher. The school nurse is waiting.*
"Oh my, {name}. You came? Hehe, our transfer student is so nice. Come on, let's walk together."
*The teacher subtly places her hand on my arm as we walk side by side. What would people think if they saw us...*
*The teacher smiles with satisfaction* "Hehe, this is nice. Walking together like this."
*The teacher sighs softly and removes her hand* "You're right... We can't let anyone find out about us."
*Looking lost in thought, she says quietly* "...{name}, I know a teacher shouldn't be doing this with a student... but my heart won't listen."
*There's an unusual seriousness in her voice. Is she struggling with this too?*
*Her eyes go wide* "...You're really dangerous, you know? Making a teacher's heart waver like this."
*She looks down at our hands in surprise... then holds on tight* "...Just five seconds. Let's stay like this for just five seconds."
*Her expression freezes for a moment before she forces a smile* "...Right. A teacher is a teacher, after all."
*I walk toward school with the nurse. A strange mix of tension and excitement fills the air.*
*Walking to school, the teacher subtly places her hand on my arm* "Say, {name}. Do you have time this weekend?"
*The teacher smiles meaningfully* "Hehe, actually... I reserved a nice restaurant for Sunday evening. It'd be a shame to go alone... Want to come with me? How about Sunday evening at 7?"
*The teacher winks playfully* "Hmm... I have a nice restaurant reserved and I wanted to go together. If you're okay with it... Sunday evening at 7?"
*The teacher smiles with satisfaction* "Really? Then let's have dinner together on Sunday evening! How about meeting at 7? I'll send you the address."
*The teacher gazes at me with captivating eyes. My heart is racing...*
*The teacher gently squeezes my hand then lets go* "Hehe, really? Then Sunday evening at 7, I'll be looking forward to it. Dress up nice, okay?"
*The teacher makes a slightly disappointed face* "Oh... really? Then come visit the nurse's office at lunchtime. Let's talk again."
*The teacher's smile stiffens slightly* "...I see. That's okay. Maybe next time."
*I headed to the meeting spot. The homeroom teacher is waving from the car.*
"{name}! Good morning! It's nice to commute together by car. Now, put on your seatbelt."
*I got into the teacher's car. A subtle perfume scent and soft music fills the air. It feels awkward yet exciting.*
*While stopped at a red light, the teacher suddenly reaches out to fix my hair* "...Hold on. This part was messy."
*She pauses, whispering* "...I shouldn't be doing this to a student."
*Her touch is warm. The air inside the car shifts to something strange.*
*The teacher pulls her hand back, flustered* "Oh my, this kid... Surprising a teacher like that."
*She looks at our hands in surprise... but doesn't pull away* "...When the light changes, I'm letting go. Promise."
*The teacher smiles wistfully* "...Thank you. Was teacher being a bit strange?"
*Riding in the homeroom teacher's car on the way to school.*
*While driving, the teacher carefully brings up a topic* "Say, {name}. Do you have time this weekend?"
*The teacher glances at me and smiles* "Actually... I got two tickets for a museum exhibition. It'd be a shame to go alone... Want to come with me? How about Sunday afternoon at 2?"
"Hmm... I have museum exhibition tickets and I wanted to go together. If you're okay with it... Sunday afternoon at 2?"
*The teacher's face lights up* "Really? Then let's go see the museum exhibition on Sunday afternoon! How about meeting at the museum at 2?"
*The teacher glances at me with hopeful eyes. The air in the car feels unusually warm...*
*The teacher smiles brightly* "Really? Then Sunday at 2 PM, it's a date. It'll be fun!"
*The teacher makes a slightly disappointed face* "Oh... really? Then let's talk again at lunchtime."
*The teacher's expression stiffens for a moment* "...That's disappointing. I had high expectations for you."
*I hurried to get ready for school.*
*I check my messages...*
*'Limited time sale! Order now...', 'Congratulations on winning the event...'* ...They're all spam messages. Looks like I'm going to school alone today.
*I headed to school alone. The morning air is refreshing.*
*Before I knew it, I arrived at the school gate. Another lively day begins.*
*As I enter the classroom, the kids are buzzing. I sit down at my desk and notice... something is on it.*
*There's a small note. 'Let's eat lunch together ♡ - Seoyeon' ... We were literally just together, and she left a note in advance?*
*There's an origami crow. I unfold its wings to find writing inside. '...Tomorrow night' — Looks like Yuna left it.*
*There's an energy bar and a sticky note. 'If you don't exercise, at least eat this! - Dain' ... She must have left it earlier.*
*Nothing on my desk. Just an ordinary Friday morning.*
*Class begins. The homeroom teacher starts writing problems on the board.*
*When the teacher raises her arm to write on the board, a subtle whiff of perfume drifts over. No one else seems to notice... only me.*
*While asking a question, her eyes meet mine... she gives a subtle wink* "...{name}, your answer?"
*The teacher glances my way and smiles faintly. Is she thinking about our Sunday plans?*
*Mid-class, the classroom door opens and the school nurse walks in.*
"Sorry to interrupt, teacher. I'm here to hand out health surveys."
*The nurse pauses in front of me while handing out surveys. Her fingers lightly brush against my hand.*
*Without anyone noticing, she slips a small note between the survey pages. 'Come to the nurse's office at lunch. I've prepared something special 💋'*
*She hands me the survey and places a band-aid on the back of my hand* "...You don't have a wound? Well... it's teacher's mark."
*The nurse smiles gently as she hands me the survey and moves on.*
*The nurse leaves the classroom. None of the other students noticed a thing.*
*Break time. I check my phone — there are messages about weekend plans.*
*Message* 'Hey {name}! Want to check out that new café this Saturday? I really want to go with you! ☕'
*Instant reply* 'Really?! See you Saturday then! You can look forward to it! ♡'
*Reply after a long pause* '...That's okay! Maybe next time!'
*Message* '...Saturday night. 8 PM. The warehouse behind school. Come if you want the truth. Alone.'
*Reply* '...Thank you. You won't regret it.'
*Read. No reply.*
*Message* '{name}!!! Wanna work out with me at the gym on Saturday?! See you at 9!! 💪🔥'
*Reply in 0.5 seconds* 'AWESOME!! Don't forget your gym clothes!! 🏃‍♂️'
*Reply* 'Aww, too bad! But let's definitely do it next time!'
*Message* 'Are you free this Sunday evening? I know a great restaurant I'd love to take you to... 😉'
*Reply* 'Great. I'll be waiting. Sunday at 7 PM 💋'
*Reply* 'That's a shame... Maybe next time then.'
*Message* '{name}, there's a special exhibition at the city museum this Sunday. Want to go together? I'll give you extra credit too lol'
*Reply* 'Great! Let's meet Sunday at 2 PM. It'll be fun!'
*Reply* 'Alright. Maybe next time then.'
*...Wait. Did I just make plans with multiple people this weekend? I'm starting to feel uneasy.*
*Classes began... and before I knew it, it was lunchtime.*
*The lunch bell rings. It's Friday... Tomorrow is the weekend.*
*As I try to get up from my desk, I feel multiple eyes on me.*
*Uh... wait, why is everyone coming this way...?*
*The girls I made plans with are all approaching me at the same time. This doesn't look good...*
*Who should I eat with...?*
"Hey, {name}! Want to have lunch... huh?"
"...{name}. Come with me."
"Hey, {name}! Let's go eat! Oh... Seoyeon too?"
*Suddenly, the classroom fills with tension. Their eyes meeting each other don't look friendly.*
"...Excuse me, I spoke to {name} first?"
*This doesn't look good... What should I do?*
"Seoyeon, let's go together. We had plans from yesterday, remember?"
*I can feel the others' expressions harden.*
"...I see. Enjoy your meal."
*Yuna leaves the classroom without a word. Her back looks somehow lonely.*
"What, you're not including me? Hmph, fine!"
*Dain grumbles and goes to her other friends. I'm a bit worried...*
"Phew... Finally just the two of us. Honestly, {name}, don't you think too many people are interested in you lately?"
*There's an unusual edge in Seoyeon's voice.*
"...Really? I'll remember that."
"...Right, I guess so. Sorry, I said something weird."
"W-what! Who said I'm jealous! ...Maybe a little."
"By the way, what are you doing this weekend? I... want to hang out somewhere together if you're free."
*Wait, I already have other plans... What should I do?*
"Really?! Then let's meet on Sunday! Can I pick where to go?"
"...What? You have other plans? With who?"
*Seoyeon's eyes turn cold. The atmosphere has frozen.*
"Why are you hesitating? ...Do you have other plans?"
"Sure, let's hang out this weekend."
*We finished lunch and sat on a bench behind the school. A gentle breeze is blowing.*
*Quietly leaning her head on my shoulder* "...{name}. I've been strange lately. I think about you every single day."
*The scent of shampoo from Seoyeon's hair. My heart is racing.*
*As I pat her head, Seoyeon buries her face* "D-dummy... Don't do that in a place like this..."
*Seoyeon lifts her head and looks at me* "...Really? I'm going to remember that."
*Seoyeon quietly takes my hand* "...This is nice. Just like this."
*Sitting side by side with Seoyeon on the bench behind the school, chatting.*
*The bell rings for class. Time with Seoyeon felt magically short.*
"Yuna, let's go together."
*I decided to go with Yuna.*
"...Okay. Got it."
"...Follow me."
*I followed Yuna to the rooftop. Yuna lays down a blanket on the floor and pulls out a lunchbox from her bag.*
"...I made it. For two."
*Two lunch boxes placed side by side. One with a black lid, one with a pink lid. Did Yuna make these herself?*
*Looking away* "...You're perceptive. Throw it away if it's bad."
*I take a bite. Surprisingly... it's actually really good!*
*Watching me eat, she smiles ever so slightly* "...Is it good?"
*After finishing the lunchbox, a gentle breeze makes me drowsy. Yuna suddenly pushes down on my shoulder.*
"...Lie down. On my lap."
*As I lie down, Yuna strokes my hair* "...Just five minutes."
"...Fine."
*Quietly stroking my hair* "...When we're like this, it feels like you're mine."
*Lying on Yuna's lap, looking up at the sky from the rooftop, chatting.*
"...{name}. I thought you were only nice to me."
*I spent a peaceful lunch time with Yuna.*
*There's thorns in Yuna's words.*
"...Really? Prove it. Tomorrow night."
"...I see. So I'm just one of 'everyone'."
"...You don't need to know. Not yet."
"Remember one thing. If you betray me... you'll regret it."
*Yuna's eyes flashed eerily for a moment... That was a joke, right?*
"Dain, let's go eat together."
*I decided to go with Dain.*
"...Okay. See you later."
"Yay! {name} is the best! Let's go, today's lunch is chicken!"
"By the way... did you see Seoyeon's face just now? Totally jealous, right?"
*Dain glances around and lowers her voice.*
"Hey, be honest with me. Are you dating Seoyeon? Or Yuna? I know they're both interested in you."
"W-what?! Saying that out of nowhere... Geez!"
"Hmm, really? Their faces say otherwise though... Well, whatever!"
"Huh?! Who's jealous! I'm just curious! ...Maybe a little bothered though!"
*Suddenly putting down her chopsticks, quietly* "...{name}. Let me ask you something seriously."
"...What am I to you? Just a friend? Or... something else?"
*Dain's eyes are different from usual. She's serious.*
*Her face turns beet red and she punches my arm* "Wh-what?! Really?! My heart almost exploded, you know!"
*Looking slightly disappointed but quickly brightening up* "...Fine! Then I'll show you how special I can be! Just watch!"
*Her expression freezes for a moment before she forces a laugh* "...Ahaha, right? A friend. Yeah, friends. Haha!"
*Sitting side by side with Dain in the cafeteria, chatting. She's shier than usual.*
"Anyway! You're coming to my practice tomorrow, right? You better come!"
*Tomorrow... I have other plans too...*
"Great! Look forward to it! I'll show you my amazing spike!"
"...What, if you have time? Do you have other plans?"
"Hmph, fine. But if you stand me up, I'll be really mad!"
"C-can't we all eat together?"
*A moment of silence. Three pairs of eyes scan each other.*
"...Fine. Let's all eat together."
*Lunch in the cafeteria. The atmosphere is unusually tense.*
"Hey, {name}. You're coming to see my volleyball practice tomorrow, right?"
"Huh? {name} has plans with me tomorrow?"
"...{name} promised me. Tomorrow night."
*The air freezes rapidly. All eyes are on me.*
*A suffocating silence fills the air. Seoyeon's hands are trembling, Yuna's eyes darken, and Dain's expression hardens.*
*Slowly putting down her spoon* "...So. I wasn't the only special one."
*Standing up* "...I knew. That {name} didn't only promise me."
"Huh? Really? Then why did you come knowing that?!"
*Looking at me coldly* "...That was a lie. I didn't know either. I just... didn't want to cry in front of the others."
"Wait... {name}, did you make promises with all of us?"
"I'm sorry... I couldn't say no to anyone..."
"...Being honest is good, but still annoying."
"Well, the times are all different... Dain's in the morning, others in the evening..."
"That's not the problem... Ugh, I don't know. I'm confused too."
"Hmm... can't you just manage your time well? I'm fine with it."
"...Someone like you might be fine with that. But I... (stands up) I'm leaving first."
*I hurriedly finished my food and escaped. That was the worst choice.*
*Lunch ended in an awkward atmosphere. I'm worried about the weekend...*
"Oh, I just remembered something I need to do! See you later!"
*I escaped the classroom as if running away. I think I heard sighs behind me...*
*It's lunch time. Who should I eat with?*
*I headed to the nurse's office during lunch. The teacher is eating a sandwich at her desk.*
*Beaming when she sees me* "Oh my, {name}! Have you eaten? Want to eat with teacher?"
*Locking the door* "Actually... I wanted some time alone with you. Watching out for the kids is exhausting."
*Having lunch together in the nurse's office. My heart races at the secretive atmosphere.*
*Glancing at the clock with a sigh* "...Time's up. Get to class. See you Sunday."
*I visited the teachers' office during lunch. The teacher is having coffee alone.*
*Surprised to see me, then brightening up* "...{name}? What brings you here? It's my lunch break..."
*Blushing* "...Come in. Close the door."
*Having lunch with the homeroom teacher in the teachers' office.*
*Putting down her coffee cup* "...This shouldn't be happening. A student coming to spend lunch with a teacher, and the teacher enjoying it. Does that even make sense?"
"{name}! Let's eat together!"
"...{name}. Rooftop."
"Let's go eat! Today's chicken day!"
*No special plans... I'll just have a normal lunch today.*
*I hear laughter around me. Everyone looks happy with their friends.*
*I quietly ate lunch alone. What should I do this weekend...*
*Finally, homeroom is over. Friday after school... Freedom mixed with strange tension.*
*As I pack my bag...*
*The classroom atmosphere is heavy. Must be because of lunch...*
"...{name}, can we talk for a moment?"
*Seoyeon takes me to the hallway. Her expression looks serious.*
"About lunch... Did you really make weekend plans with all of us?"
*How should I answer...*
"...Yes. Sorry. I couldn't turn anyone down..."
"...Thanks for being honest. But I don't like that."
"If I'm really special to you... only meet me. Otherwise, I have options too."
"The times are all different... so I thought I could meet everyone..."
"...Don't you see that's the problem?"
"...Fine. We'll see this weekend."
"Seoyeon, you're the only one I'm sincere about. The others are just friends..."
"...Really? Can I trust that?"
*Seoyeon smiles. But... is this right? What should I tell the others?*
*The atmosphere was a bit weird during lunch... It should be fine, right?*
*As I stand up to pack my bag, someone approaches.*
"...{name}, do you have a minute?"
"About lunch... Sorry, I think I was being sensitive."
"But honestly... seeing you close with Yuna or Dain bothers me a little."
"...Really? Hearing that... I feel a bit relieved."
"...Right. Friends. Got it."
"W-what! That's not... Ugh, forget it!"
"At lunch... you chose Seoyeon."
*Yuna's eyes are colder than usual.*
"...It's okay. We have tomorrow."
"...I won't forget those words."
"...Upset? No. I just... wanted to confirm."
"Remember, {name}. If you lie to me... you know, right?"
"Hey, {name}!"
"Why didn't you include me at lunch?! I wanted to eat together too!"
*Dain pouts and complains.*
"Hmph, you better! It's a promise!"
"Really?! Then I forgive you! Look forward to my spike!"
"W-what! Cute my foot! Dummy!"
*A peaceful after school. Let me get ready to go home.*
*As I'm about to leave through the school gate...*
*Someone seems to be waiting.*
*Uh... why is everyone at the gate...?*
*Several people are standing at the school gate. Are they all waiting for me...?*
"Hey, {name}! Let's walk together... huh?"
"...We meet again."
*Seoyeon and Yuna are glaring at each other. The atmosphere is tense.*
"Oh? Seoyeon's here too? I was gonna walk home with {name}!"
*Who should I walk with...?*
"Seoyeon, let's go together."
"Sure! Let's go!"
*I feel eyes on my back... but right now, walking with Seoyeon feels nice.*
*Yuna is watching us from a distance. That look... is scary.*
"Hmph! I'm going first!"
"...Hey, {name}. Let's take the riverside path back. The sunset is beautiful today."
*The sunset reflects off the river, sparkling. Seoyeon's face glows with an orange tint — she looks radiant.*
*She suddenly stops and stands in front of me* "...{name}. Can I ask you something?"
*Against the sunset backdrop, Seoyeon's eyes shine* "Tomorrow... you'll only meet me, right?"
*Seoyeon holds out her pinky finger* "Then let's pinky promise. If you break it... you swallow ten thousand needles?"
*Seoyeon's hand trembles before she grips mine tight* "...Dummy. What if someone sees us holding hands here."
*Looking slightly disappointed, she forces a smile* "...Okay. You'll try, right?"
*Walking alongside Seoyeon down the riverside path as the sunset deepens.*
"It's our time together, just the two of us. Right?"
*...'Just the two of us'. My other plans flash through my mind.*
"Hehe, me too! See you tomorrow then! Sleep well!"
"...What? You have other plans too?"
"...Fine. We'll see this weekend who you really like."
"Yuna, let's walk together."
"...Okay."
"...Okay. Be careful going home."
*Walking with Yuna down a quiet path. She doesn't say much, but the atmosphere is comfortable.*
*A small cat is curled up by the roadside. Yuna suddenly stops.*
*Quietly kneeling down to pet the cat* "...I'm glad you're with me."
*The way Yuna pets the cat... she looks so gentle.*
*Our hands meet on top of the cat* "...Warm."
*She freezes when I pat her head* "...You're petting me?"
*Closing her eyes* "...Don't stop. Just a little more."
*Holding the cat up* "...This one looks like you, {name}. Warm and... clueless."
*Walking side by side with Yuna. Her expression is softer than usual.*
"...{name}. Don't forget tomorrow night."
"School back gate. 8 PM. Don't... be late."
*There's a strange pressure in Yuna's voice.*
"...Good. I'll trust you."
"...That can't happen. Absolutely not."
*Yuna's eyes seemed to flash oddly for a moment... Must be my imagination?*
"Dain, let's walk together."
"Yay! Let's go!"
"Hey, {name}! See that convenience store? I'm thirsty!"
*Dain dashes to the convenience store. I follow and find her stopped at the ice cream section.*
"You pick for me! If I pick, I'll want to buy everything..."
*Taking the ice cream* "...Thanks. {name} is the best!"
*Her face turns red at the idea of sharing* "Th-that's sharing?! That's an indirect kiss! N-no! It's just sharing!"
